title: Name numerology calculator (Chaldean)
description: Find the number of your name with Chaldean letter values: each letter's value, the compound total and the single-digit name number with its planet.
intro: Name numerology gives each letter a number and adds them up. Enter your name as you usually write it to see every letter's value, the compound total, the single-digit name number and the planet traditionally associated with it.

sections.heading: The Chaldean system
body: Indian name numerology usually follows the Chaldean system, in which letters take values from 1 to 8 according to their sound. The number 9 is not assigned to any letter. We add the values of all letters, show the compound total, and then reduce it to one digit.
Spaces, hyphens, dots and apostrophes are ignored. The tables use the Latin alphabet, so names written in Devanagari need to be typed in English letters for now.

sections.heading: How it is used
body: Numerologists compare the name number with the mulank and bhagyank from the date of birth. Spelling changes alter the total, which is why people sometimes compare a few spellings. We calculate; we do not recommend spelling changes.

faqs.q: Should I enter my full name?
faqs.a: Use the name you use most, for example the name you sign with. Results differ between spellings.

faqs.q: Can I enter a Hindi name in Devanagari?
faqs.a: Not yet. Please type it in English letters. Letter tables for Devanagari would need their own tradition and review.
The total of all letter values before it is reduced to a single digit.

faqs.q: Why does the letter Q have value 1?
faqs.a: Chaldean values group letters by sound, not alphabet order, so the pattern looks irregular. The full table is shown in the result.
